description: This file defines the ConsoleMailingListener class, which is responsible for handling events related to mailing processes in the Goteo application. It includes methods to handle sending mails, starting, finishing, and aborting mailings, and interacts with feed logging and mailing state management.

classes.name: ConsoleMailingListener
classes.description: Listener class handling mailing-related events such as send, start, finish, and abort within the Goteo console application.

methods.name: onSendMail
methods.description: Handles the event of sending an individual mail recipient, logs success or throws exception on failure.

methods.name: onMailingStart
methods.description: Handles the start of the mailing process, logs an informational message.

methods.name: onMailingFinish
methods.description: Handles the completion of the mailing process, creates a feed entry, and updates mailing status.

methods.name: onMailingAbort
methods.description: Handles aborting a mailing, unlocks blocked mailings, and raises exceptions if necessary.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of event-to-method mappings for event subscription.
